hints.title: Check Monotonicity on Minimum Sweetness
hints.text: If a minimum sweetness s is achievable across k + 1 continuous pieces, any smaller threshold is also achievable.

hints.title: Greedy Piece Verification
hints.text: Traverse sweetness accumulating values into a chunk; as soon as a chunk reaches s, finalize the piece and start a new one.

hints.title: Search Optimal Sweetness Bound
hints.text: Perform binary search between 1 and the total sweetness divided by k + 1 to find the maximum valid threshold.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: SUM: sum of all sweetness values
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Partitioning an array into k + 1 segments with DP takes O(k * N^2) time, which is too slow.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Binary search on answer evaluates viability in O(N) per guess with constant space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that maximizing the minimum piece is solved via binary search on answer.
complexity.notes: Number of pieces required is k + 1 (you plus k friends).
